owner_posts.post_text: Financial success rarely begins with a big amount. More often, it begins with one disciplined decision repeated consistently over time. Habits can create more progress than most people realize.

Financial literacy is not about predicting the next winning stock. It’s about understanding your cash flow, your savings, and whether your financial goals are truly on track. That clarity creates confidence.
Strong financial planning is built step by step. Before focusing on wealth creation, it helps to secure the basics — from emergency savings and insurance to investing and long-term legacy planning.
Many people wait to invest because they believe they need to earn more first. In reality, strong financial habits are often what create future growth, confidence, and better money decisions.
A small SIP may not seem powerful at the start, but consistency can turn modest beginnings into meaningful progress over time. The amount matters less than the discipline behind the habit.

Couples Don't Fight About Money. They Fight About Invisible Expectations.

Many couples think money problems begin when income is low.

From what I've observed, that's rarely the real issue.

One partner wants experiences.

The other wants security.

One thinks ₹3 lakh should go towards Europe.

The other thinks it belongs in an emergency fund.

One sees money as freedom.

The other sees money as protection.

And neither person is wrong.

Money arguments are often not about money.

They're about priorities that were never discussed.

The happiest couples I've seen don't necessarily earn the most.

They simply make financial decisions together before life makes those decisions for them.

Because financial compatibility isn't about having the same salary.

It's about having the same direction.

Building wealth is important, but protecting it is equally valuable. True financial planning is not only about earning more — it’s about creating a strategy that helps preserve what you’ve worked hard to build.

Before focusing on wealth creation, it’s important to build financial stability. An emergency fund, proper insurance, and managing high-interest debt can create the foundation needed for smarter investing decisions.
When it comes to investing, time can be more valuable than the amount you invest. Starting earlier gives compounding more time to work, which can make a significant difference in long-term outcomes.
Financial goals evolve over time, and your portfolio should evolve with them. Regular reviews help ensure your strategy remains aligned with your priorities, risk profile, and changing life needs.

His structured approach towards SIP planning, tax-saving strategies, portfolio management, and wealth creation is highly professional and transparent.

I highly recommend Chandan to anyone looking for trustworthy and result-oriented financial advice.”

featured_reviews.name: Niranjan Dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been associated with Mr. Chandan Degvekar from Vijaya Financial Services for over 10 years now, and I can confidently say he’s been a pillar of support in my financial journey. From the very beginning, his approach has been refreshingly honest and client-first. He doesn’t push you into investment products; instead, he takes the time to understand your situation holistically and recommends what’s genuinely best for you. His humility, patience, and kindness make him not just an advisor but a trusted guide.

One of the biggest reasons I’ve stuck with him for so long is his ability to handle bottlenecks seamlessly. Whether it’s dealing with LIC or other financial institutions, he and his team work like magicians to resolve issues efficiently, leaving me completely tension-free.

A recent experience truly highlighted his dedication. My mother needed breast surgery at Kokilaben Ambani Hospital, and we were struggling for hours with the TPA at the hospital desk to get cashless hospitalization approval under her Star Health policy. I was helpless and frustrated. A single call to Mr. Chandan with all the details, and within minutes, the cashless approval came through. It felt like a miracle, but it was just his expertise and prompt action that saved the day.

What sets him apart is his team’s proactive support. They handle all the administrative work required with financial firms and investment companies, so I never have to worry about paperwork or follow-ups. Plus, he sends timely reminders for premium payments, ensuring I never miss a deadline or face a policy lapse.

If you’re looking for a financial advisor who genuinely cares, is exceptionally skilled at resolving issues, and offers complete peace of mind, look no further than Mr. Chandan Degvekar and his team at Vijaya Financial Services.

Kudos to him and his incredible team for their unwavering commitment and excellence!
